sources.entry: StyleSeed by kiwiman - A design engine that takes a different tack from "feed the model more tokens": it teaches design *judgment* — ~74 rules pros carry but never write down ("the refined black isn't #000, it's #2A2A2A"; "one accent color, everything else grayscale") — as plain markdown the agent reads automatically, plus a brand-agnostic skin system, a named motion vocabulary, and /ss-* review s

summary.one_liner: StyleSeed is an MIT-licensed design-judgment engine that gives coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) recorded expert design rules, brand skins, a motion vocabulary, and scored review/verify workflows for building UI.
summary.what_it_does: It ships 74 plain-markdown design rules (DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md) that agents read, covering things like avoiding default accent colors, icon-in-chip cliches, and tokens-only hex usage. A context compiler (/styleseed resolve) turns the selected grammar, adapter, brand recipe, and palette into a small hash-verified bundle instead of loading the full handbook. A project design lock (STYLESEED.md) records skin, key color, radius, and motion so later sessions stay consistent. The build loop scores output 0-100 and asks the agent to revise below 80 before presenting, and /styleseed verify renders the screen to check it visually. The package also includes 48 React components, seven built-in token skins, nine brand recipes, eight palette recipes, and five named motion seeds with a keyword library. The README says the score does not replace human design acceptance.
use_cases: enforce consistent UI design in AI-generated frontend code
score and revise generated screens before showing them
retrofit a generic-looking existing app with design rules
keep color, type, and radius decisions consistent across sessions
generate React components and dashboard pages with a design system
create social carousels, decks, or documents with a visual style
how_to_run: npx -y skills add bitjaru/styleseed -a codex claude-code -y --copy
Send a build request, e.g. /styleseed build or $styleseed Help improve this screen
Manual alternative: git clone the repo and copy engine/.claude/skills into .claude/skills or .agents/skills
notable: Design rules are written as judgment (why and when to apply a pattern) and stored as plain markdown the agent reads automatically
Enforced score-then-fix loop: the build workflow scores UI and revises below 80 before presentation
Project design lock (STYLESEED.md) plus a source-hashed context compiler to limit drift and token use
Brand recipes change structure and components, not just palette; token skins change color and type material
Named motion vocabulary with five seeds and copy-paste keyword moves, respecting reduced motion
caveats: The README states the score is not expert approval and rules are not universal taste; human design acceptance is still required
Enforcement depends on the agent actually invoking the workflow; a markdown file alone cannot block delivery
Best results need installation (Node.js/npm) and the skills loaded; without install, the compiler and gates are a weaker manual path
The optional ss-learn extension is repository-only and not part of the public install
